raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a multi-series line plot showing training loss versus iteration for six model variants, with a legend in the upper-right listing: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000 with major ticks every 20,000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging from about 2.4 to 3.4 with ticks at 0.1 increments. Each series is drawn as a solid line with a faint, same-colored shaded band around it indicating variability; no point markers are used. All curves start near the top of the axis (around 3.4 at iteration 0), drop steeply within the first several thousand iterations, then decrease gradually toward the end. The StrmLLM (n=64) line (blue) remains highest throughout, falling to roughly 2.8 by ~20k iterations and ending near about 2.62 at 140k. The Vanilla line (purple) drops quickly to around 2.65 by ~20k and ends near about 2.47–2.48 at 140k. SepLLM (n=64) (orange) declines to roughly 2.70 by ~20k and ends near about 2.52 at 140k. SepLLM (n=64, H) (green) follows a similar trajectory, around ~2.69 at ~20k and about ~2.51 at 140k. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red) is slightly lower than the other SepLLM n=64 variants, around ~2.67 at ~20k and about ~2.49–2.50 at 140k. SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue) tracks close to the SepLLM n=64 variants, around ~2.68 at ~20k and ending near ~2.50 at 140k.
